full_text: Republic of the Philippines DEPARTMENT OF THE INTERIOR AND LOCAL GOVERNMENT A. Francisco Gold Condominium II Bldg, EDSA corner Mapagmahal St., Diliman, Quezon City DILG OPINION NO. 37 S. 2010 March 31, 2010 VICE MAYOR NAZARIO GASTARDO San Francisco, Surigao del Norte Dear Vice Mayor Gastardo: This pertains to your letter seeking our legal opinion on who has the authority to approve travel orders insofar as the official trips of sangguniang bayan members are concerned. In reply thereto, please be intormea that we had already an occasion to answer a similar query in DILG Opinion No. 20 series of 2008, dated April 10, 2008. Attached herewith is a photocopy of DILG Opinion No. 20, series of 2008 for your ready perusal. We hope this settles your concern. Very truly yours, BY AUTHORITY OF THE SECRETARY: ATTY. JESUS B. DOQI.JE IV Director III Legal: 94: ins
